owner_wording: Install a dishwasher, washing machine and tumble dryer. A heat pump dryer is quieter and more energy efficient.
source: Appraisal contingency + Owner Intranet Mandatory Amenities

owner_wording: Install air conditioning in the main living areas.
Connect NBN wifi with a minimum speed of 50Mbps (no dongles), with the 2.4GHz band enabled.
source: Appraisal contingency + Owner Intranet Mandatory Amenities

owner_wording: Supply an espresso machine. A Nespresso compatible pod machine is the simplest option for guests.
Install smoke alarms that meet AS 3786 and provide a fire safety certificate before the property goes live.
Fully equip the kitchen with a stove, oven, microwave, 4-slice toaster and kettle, plus crockery, cutlery and glassware for twice the maximum guest capacity.
Supply a high chair and a portacot.
Furnish the property to a good standard throughout, replacing worn, budget or mismatched pieces.
Bring the property to excellent overall condition, with a high standard of cosmetic presentation inside and out.
Remove personal and family photos, valuables and personal belongings.
Install keyless entry or a combination lock box at the front door. Please avoid systems that need a new code for each guest or an app.
Install a sensor light at the entry door so guests arriving at night can find their way in safely.
Add lighting to the deck and outdoor living areas so guests can use them in the evening.
Provide an outdoor dining table and chairs that seat the full guest capacity, in low-maintenance, weather-resistant materials (no cheap plastic).
Supply a quality BBQ sized for the guest capacity (no cheap flat plate models), with cleaning tools and two gas cylinders.
Create an outdoor lounge area with comfortable seating, a daybed or sun loungers.
Refresh the exterior presentation, for example painting, pressure cleaning and repairing visible damage.
Provide the garbage bins required for the guest capacity. Your local council can supply additional bins.
Fit a small hose on a reel for guests to rinse dogs, cars or boats.
Arrange regular garden care, including mowing, edging, leaf blowing, trimming and weeding.
Fully enclose the garden with no gaps in the fencing (or add a fenced dog run) so the property can be marketed as pet friendly.
source: Appraisal contingency (pet friendly) + Owner Intranet Pets

owner_wording: Supply dog water bowls and dog toys.
Install a fire pit. Properties with fire pits consistently perform better through winter.
Clear overgrown areas, garden waste and stored items from the yard.
Refresh the front garden beds to lift street appeal and the first photo guests see.
Provide enough seating for the full guest capacity, using a mix of couches, armchairs and occasional seating.
Choose leather or leather-look couches, or have fabric couches stain protected, to make cleaning easier.
Install a large smart TV (75 inch where space allows), or add a Google TV device to an existing TV.
source: Owner Intranet Mandatory Amenities + Living Areas

owner_wording: Supply a portable Bluetooth speaker.
Add coffee and side tables near the seating, with protectors on the feet.
Add enclosed storage for books, magazines and board games.
Hang one or two good-sized artworks, ideally reflecting the local area.
Add lamps for reading and evening lighting. Dimmer switches also help create atmosphere.
Reduce ornaments to a few pieces that reflect the local area.
Provide a dining table and chairs so every guest can sit down to eat at the same time.
Upgrade the double bed to a queen bed.
Replace metal-framed or budget beds with quality beds such as timber frames.
Replace the mattress with a quality mattress of medium softness.
Add bunk beds (double or king single, with secure ladders) to increase guest capacity.
Add bedside tables and lamps on both sides of the bed, with tables higher than the top of the mattress.
Provide hanging space with at least six wooden coat hangers and drawer storage.
Fit blackout blinds or curtains.
Provide a fan and a heater, as the room has no air conditioning. Oil column heaters are a safe, low-cost option.
Supply a doona for each bed plus a spare per bed size, and two pillows per single bed and four per queen bed.
Add a labelled power board or USB charging point near the bed.
Supply shampoo, conditioner, shower gel and hand soap in a pump dispenser.
Add a shower caddy or shelf for toiletries.
Add storage or shelving so guests have space for their toiletries.
Supply a hair dryer.
Fit a toilet roll holder in an obvious spot and supply a toilet brush.
Supply an air freshener block and spray.
Refresh worn grout, silicone, tapware or mirrors.
Install or repair the exhaust fan to control damp and mould.
Equip the laundry with an iron and ironing board, vacuum, mop, bucket, broom and clothes airer.
Upgrade the hot water system to the minimum size for the guest capacity. A heat pump system is recommended.
Hold short-term rental insurance covering public liability, accidental damage, malicious damage and loss of rent.
Install a carbon monoxide detector if the property uses gas heating.
source: Owner Intranet Fire Safety (source says CO2 detector; carbon monoxide assumed)
craig_notes: Source page says CO2. Confirm intended wording.

owner_wording: From 1 May, supply firewood, firelighters and fire tools if there is a fireplace or fire pit, plus extra blankets for every bed.
Add family extras such as board games, toys, a games console or beach gear.
